facts.value: Students who have earned an Associate of Applied Science from a regionally accredited institution may transfer 60 credit hours toward the Bachelor of Applied Science degree.

Students who have earned an Associate of Applied Science degree from a regionally accredited Arizona community college may be eligible to transfer up to 75 credits toward the Bachelor of Applied Science degree.
Students pursuing the 75 credit option may have more than 45 credit hours to complete their BAS upon transfer to ASU.
Students should work with their academic advisor to ensure their courses will meet degree requirements.
